theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials are ranked #3 with high durability (0.79), a ‘trend’ Hurst tag, solid breadth (0.816), and eligibility under the absolute-trend gate. Crowding (z=1.06) is noted as a sizing caution, but the trend-health indicators support a marginal overweight relative to a fading leader and themes with weaker trend structures.
theses.dissent: Crowding and a mean-reverting impulse from the fading leader could whipsaw financials; the desk’s own track record (7 misses in 11 calls) warns against any near-term directional edge.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care (rank #2) shows the highest breadth (0.898) and decent durability (0.69), passing the absolute-trend gate. Although the Hurst tag is ‘mixed’ and the theme is crowded (z=1.68), the breadth/durability combination suggests it may hold up better than the fading leader in a broad eligibility environment. Crowding is treated as a sizing caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: A mixed Hurst tag and high crowding raise the risk of a sharp reversal if the macro narrative shifts; the sector could underperform if the AI/tech narrative reasserts itself despite the leader’s fading.
